explanation: Compared against Written on the Wall II (archived all.html and the definitions file wowIIdefs.js from cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/, via the Wayback Machine; the live site does not respond), Conjecture 17 (status T, July 3, 2003; 'Independently proven by Benny John, UHD (Dec. 2005) and David Schindl (Jan. 2006)'): 'If G is a simple connected graph, then b(G) ≥ α(G) + CEIL(diam(G)/3)', with b(G) the maximum number of vertices of an induced bipartite subgraph, α the independence number and diam the maximum eccentricity. Lean: for connected G on a finite nontrivial type, (indepNum G : ℝ) + ⌈(diam G : ℝ)/3⌉ ≤ b G, with G.diam Mathlib's natural-number diameter (the true diameter for a connected finite graph) and b G the real cast of the largest size of a vertex set inducing a bipartite graph. Direct transcription; faithful.
